design.anchor: Use B or P with emission at least .55 and corresponding low-pass proposal within 40 ms. Compare them with independently detected visible lip releases. Retain the separate points for M midpoint and B/P release from the preceding studies.
design.clock: Exclude B/P anchors within 420 ms of an M proposal. Search audio-minus-picture shifts from -240 to +240 ms. At each shift match to a unique nearest visible release within 60 ms. Require two different releases at least 160 ms apart. Use the median residual and decline clusters whose members differ by more than 60 ms. Among maximal support clusters choose lowest sum of residual errors. Decline another maximal-support cluster 80 ms away with residual error at most 25 ms larger. Use zero when context is missing in corrected arm.
design.sources: Keep the previous six development and ten held speaker groups. Reuse their decoded native aperture and source clock. Rerun acoustic inference with M, B and P and four new clean soundtrack offsets, plus two local dubs with an additional global shift. Speakers and native pictures have prior exposure.
design.test: Score the minimum observed lip aperture in the same 100/160 ms windows and retain the strongest M candidate. Use the previous fixed points and separately show correction with mandatory anchor support. Display picture and sound ranges on their own clocks. Require .40 temporal IoU and the same M time tolerance as the parent.
